paper_role: Decisive feasibility gate for calibration-guided continuous REM-Net; not a replacement for final 11-fold evidence
hypothesis: Once a deployable session lag+affine calibration removes the low-dimensional timing/scale nuisance, Event and Morphology conditioning can interact to recover continuous ECG morphology beyond that strong conventional control.
protocol: MMECG loso_v2 development validation folds 1/5/9; first 20 seconds of every record are paired radar/reference-ECG calibration; query windows start at or after 20 seconds and share no source samples with calibration
frontend: For each record, fit lag and affine parameters on its calibration prefix only; apply them to frozen B1 predictions and shift its event logits by the same lag. No query ECG enters calibration.
identity_control: The residual output layer is zero initialized, so epoch 0 is byte-equivalent to conventional lag+affine and is eligible for checkpoint selection.

factorial_arms.neither: trained parameter-matched residual with zero morphology token and unit event gate
factorial_arms.event_only: trained residual with aligned event gate and zero morphology token
factorial_arms.morphology_only: trained residual with calibration morphology token and unit event gate
factorial_arms.full: morphology-token FiLM residual modulated by the aligned event gate

parity: All four learned arms use identical parameters, data, frontend, loss, budget, seed, decoder and checkpoint rule; pathway switches mask information without removing parameters.
budget: 80 epochs, patience 20, AdamW lr=1e-4 weight_decay=1e-4, batch 16, effective seed=42+fold
checkpoint_selection: validation query-only continuous composite; epoch 0 conventional identity included; Shape-200 excluded

gate.stage_1: fold 1 full arm improves PCC over its epoch-0 conventional identity by >=0.05, with RMSE no higher and R2 no lower
gate.stage_2: only after stage_1, run all four learned arms on folds 1/5/9; full improves all subjects, fold-macro gain over conventional >=0.05, and E-by-M interaction is positive
gate.stage_3: only after stage_2, design final 11-fold and CR_RVS experiments

test_policy: development validation only; MMECG test files remain unopened
shape200: not computed, not used in loss, selection, gate or headline
